product_overview: HeavenMatch Contact Page is a cutting-edge AI-powered customer support platform tailored for a matrimony service. It leverages 14 advanced AI features to deliver real-time, empathetic, multilingual support with smart routing, proactive assistance, and seamless human agent escalation to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.
core_goals: Provide instant, 24/7 AI-driven customer support with empathetic, context-aware responses.
Enable multi-language communication to cater to a global user base.
Automate ticket creation and support routing to optimize operational efficiency.
Enhance user satisfaction through emotion detection, priority classification, and proactive assistance.
Facilitate seamless escalation to human agents for complex or urgent issues.
Provide business intelligence insights including sentiment tracking, intent analytics, and language usage statistics.
key_features: Real-time AI Chat Widget delivering instant and concise conversational responses with typing indicators and message history.
Intent Detection classifying user queries into categories: billing, technical, safety, account, profile_match, and general.
Information Extraction to auto-fill contact form with user details like name, email, phone, and subject.
FAQ Search with AI enhancement for instant access to 8 pre-built frequently asked questions.
Smart Routing recommending the best support channel (email, phone, ticket, chat) based on intent and priority.
Automated Ticket Creation featuring unique IDs, priority assignment, sentiment data, and conversation summaries.
Sentiment Analysis detecting 18 distinct emotions to adjust AI responses with visual indicators.
Automatic Language Detection supporting multiple languages with UI adaptation and AI response localization.
Smart Quick Replies offering three AI-generated response suggestions for easy user interaction.
Conversation Summary generation for effective agent handoff capturing key user concerns and resolutions.
Smart Escalation for automatic routing of complex, urgent, or sensitive issues to human agents.
Priority Detection classifying issues as low, medium, or high urgency for efficient handling.
Context Memory maintaining conversation history to ensure relevant and non-repetitive AI responses.
Proactive Assistance that identifies when users need help and offers relevant guidance.
user_flow_summary: User visits Contact Page and accesses the contact form and live chat widget.
Upon clicking Live Chat, AI initiates conversation greeting the user.
User sends messages which trigger AI processing including language detection, intent classification, sentiment and urgency analysis.
AI provides context-aware answers, visual sentiment cues, and quick reply suggestions dynamically during the chat.
Information extraction runs automatically after initial exchanges to populate the contact form.
If suitable, AI suggests ticket creation and monitors if escalation to human support is required.
Users interact with quick replies or routing suggestions to streamline support experience.
Support tickets created by the system include comprehensive summaries and metadata for efficient follow-up.
validation_criteria: AI chat responses are delivered in under 3 seconds with accurate context and sentiment adjustment.
Intent detection correctly classifies user queries into all defined categories with over 95% accuracy.
Information extraction populates contact forms with correct user details in at least 98% of cases.
FAQ search returns relevant and helpful answers drawn from the 8 predefined topics with AI enhancement.
Smart routing provides appropriate channel recommendations consistent with query types and urgencies.
Tickets generated contain unique IDs, conversation summaries, user info, priority levels, and sentiment data correctly.
Sentiment analysis identifies the correct emotion among 18 options and updates UI indicators accordingly.
Language detection accurately identifies users' languages and adjusts UI and AI responses appropriately.
Quick reply suggestions are contextually relevant and refresh dynamically with conversation progress.
Conversation summaries capture the main issue, user concern, and suggested solutions in clear 2-3 sentence formats.
Smart escalation triggers human agent intervention on complex or high-priority cases without false positives.
Priority detection aligns urgency categorization with user sentiment and issue seriousness consistently.
Context memory maintains full conversation history without repeating information in AI responses.
Proactive assistance correctly identifies users needing help and offers timely guidance without disruption.
